name: Floors route → RETRY: not clean, budget remains → re-dispatch Amelia
description:
The retry route (design R1/R3, group 5). When the attempt was NOT clean (route.attempt.unclean=true, stamped by 06b's OR-collapse) AND the task's iteration budget still has room (route.attempt.instance count < 3, the mirror of task.attempt.instance), spawn a FRESH developer loop (Amelia) to revise the fix. That fresh loop re-arms the whole chain FOR FREE: terminate → floors (05) re-mirrors → route again, until the task advances or the budget is exhausted (escalate, 06d).

⚠ SERIALIZATION INVARIANT (load-bearing, pinned): this rule, dispatch-developer (04), and the review-retry route (07b) are the ONLY three rules permitted to spawn a role=developer loop. The chain is strictly serial (one developer loop in flight per task), which is what guarantees floors evaluated the SAME frozen checkout the attempt measured (it replaced the dropped token handshake). A fourth developer-spawner would race the shared checkout.

TRIGGER = the developer loop L_n: route.attempt.unclean eq "true" (required:false — the intermediate exists only on a not-clean developer loop L_n) AND route.attempt.instance length_lt 3 (required:true — length_* over the attempt mirror; safe on absence = empty array) AND route.attempt.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). It is mutually exclusive with escalate (06d, length_gt 2): length_lt 3 = {0,1,2}, length_gt 2 = {3,4,...} partition the count with no gap and no overlap (fail-closed — retry provably cannot fire at count ≥ 3).

RUN BINDING + ATTEMPT COUNT (R3): run_scope=inherit binds the fresh developer loop to the run (the developer loop L_n's agent.loop.run), and on_enter appends task.attempt.instance = $entity.instance on the RUN (subject-override the developer loop L_n's agent.run.entity-id) AT SPAWN — so the count rises exactly +1 per retry dispatch and the next floors route sees the incremented budget.

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe, CRITICAL): on_enter FIRST stamps route.attempt.routed=$entity.instance on the developer loop L_n, guarded by route.attempt.routed length_eq 0, BEFORE the publish. publish_agent is NOT idempotent — a re-fire would spawn a DUPLICATE developer, breaking the one-in-flight invariant. A fresh floors loop per attempt re-arms it.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.developer
on_enter.prompt:
SEMDEV DEVELOPER (Amelia) — your previous attempt at this run's task did NOT pass the sandbox gate (the test failed or a structural floor rejected it). Revise the fix.

Your run entity ID is $entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id. Read the task contract and your prior recorded measurement/floor findings with query_entity(entity_id="$entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id"); read the files with read_workspace. Author a CORRECTED unified diff touching only task.spec.target-files and record it with apply_patch, then measure_task(task_index=0). Iterate until the test passes, then stop. You author the fix; the harness measures it and you never claim the outcome (G3).

metadata.station: route retry — not clean + budget remains → re-dispatch Amelia (R1/R3, group 5)
metadata.serialization_invariant: this rule + dispatch-developer (04) + review-retry (07b) are the ONLY sanctioned role=developer spawners (pinned) — one developer in flight per task, so floors saw the same frozen checkout.
metadata.budget: route.attempt.instance length_lt 3 (the mirror of task.attempt.instance count vs the constant budget 3). Partitions the count with escalate's length_gt 2 (no gap, no overlap): retry provably cannot fire at count ≥ 3.
metadata.attempt_count: on_enter appends task.attempt.instance on the RUN at spawn (R3), so the count rises exactly +1 per retry and the next route sees it.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via route.attempt.routed (shared, LOOP-scoped) + length_eq 0 guard, stamped BEFORE the publish — CRITICAL: the publish is not idempotent (a re-fire duplicates the developer and breaks the one-in-flight invariant).
